target_segments: Documented disease progression on, or documented intolerance to, first-line platinum therapy.

sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: documented disease progression on therapy and intolerance to therapy are distinct, independently evaluable eligibility pathways. The shared first-line platinum therapy context applies to both branches.

text_span: documented intolerance to, first-line platinum therapy
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: documented intolerance is a distinct clinical basis for eligibility from disease progression, with first-line platinum therapy as its treatment context.
